title: Streaming + toolchain interoperability prober and smoke suite
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a lightweight, deterministic prober and smoke-test suite that validates interoperability across core API features: streaming payload boundaries, multi-step tool/function call sequences, structured (JSON/CSV) outputs, and backward-compatible API surface for different model/runtime variants. The goal is a CI-canary that executes fast (~<90s per matrix cell) and surfaces regressions (semantic diffs, missing function call events, schema violations, and streaming truncation) with actionable failure reasons.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible 'prober' binary (node/python) that can run locally and in CI and targets a runtime endpoint via configured credentials.

Golden prompt set (~60 concise prompts) covering: streaming chunk boundaries, mid-stream function/tool invocation, partial outputs then resume, explicit structured schema enforcement, and error/fallback behaviors.
CI matrix defined in GitHub Actions that runs the prober across 3 model variants (open-small, open-medium, open-quant) and 2 runtime flags (streaming_v2 ON/OFF) with max runtime <15m for full matrix.
Automatic triage: failing runs create a GitHub issue with test name, diff artifact, and minimal repro prompt + request metadata.
False-positive rate <2% after initial tuning (measured over 10 runs), and documented mitigation steps for common flakiness (rate limits, transient kernel OOMs).
updates: 2026-03-02 - Spike complete: prototype prober in Python using requests + websocket stream consumer. Found that partial tool-call events are emitted as separate frames in streaming_v2; need canonical event markers for the harness.

2026-03-04 - Decision: standardize on NDJSON frames with 'event': 'chunk'|'tool_call'|'tool_result'|'end' to make diffs deterministic. Sent proposal for review: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/API/Streaming+Event+Envelope
2026-03-05 - Trade-off: strict schema enforcement helps triage but increases false positives for older model variants. Implemented a leniency mode for open-small in CI matrix.

2026-03-07 - PR opened for prober + GH Actions matrix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1423. Initial runs show 3 failures on structured-output tests due to missing closing braces in one quantized model path.

2026-03-09 - Reviewed by PM and SDK lead: reduced golden prompts to 60 and added metadata capture (request headers, tokenization counts). Next step: add artifact upload of raw stream and normalized canonicalization for diffs.

2026-03-10 - Canaries running in staging nightly. Failures now auto-triaged to 'api-compatibility' team board with links to raw artifacts. Observed one recurring flake tied to autoscaling cold-start latency; filing ENG-54200 to investigate further.
testing_matrix: limit:parallel_cells - 6 to keep CI runner costs bounded
failure_modes: stream-truncation - detected when final 'end' event missing; triaged as streaming pipeline regression
missing-tool-event - tool_call frame never emitted; categorized as serialization or kernel scheduling bug
schema-violation - structured JSON doesn't validate against golden schema; may be model-side generation or tokenization mismatch
flaky-timeout - transient infra (cold-start/autoscale); tracked separately with run history
implementation_notes: Normalize raw streams into canonical NDJSON before diffing to avoid spurious whitespace/tokenizer differences.
Capture both request metadata and tokenization counts to help reproduce subtle model/output drift.
Expose a 'leniency_profile' per model variant in the harness to avoid blocking releases for older quantized paths.
Use signed artifact URLs stored in S3 for failed runs; attach to auto-created issues for faster debugging.
qa_run_plan: Phase 1: run prober against staging runtime for 7 days to collect baseline flakiness metrics.
Phase 2: enable pre-merge-smoke in GH Actions for any PR touching streaming/tooling layers.
Phase 3: gated rollout to production canary after three consecutive clean nightly runs.
Phase 4: periodic review meeting (weekly for 3 weeks) with SDK and Runtime teams to adjust golden prompts and leniency profiles.
observability_hooks: Upload raw stream and normalized diff to S3 on failure: s3://redwood-ci/api-prober/<run-id>/
Add tracing span for prober->runtime request including kernel selection/header flags to correlate with infra traces
